about: An AI tutor that adapts to each learner and keeps helping them over time.

prs.title: Titles with quote marks keep the rest of the reference
prs.broken: A reference title with quote marks in it was cut at the first quote. The title became one word and the authors and year were lost.
prs.changed: A quote mark inside braces no longer ends the title.
prs.matters: Imported references keep their full title, authors and year.

prs.title: Author names with Jr and group names show correctly
prs.broken: Names like King, Jr., Martin Luther came out jumbled, and group names like Food and Agriculture Organization were split into two authors.
prs.changed: Names are split only outside braces, and the Jr part goes in its place.
prs.matters: References exported from Zotero list their authors the right way.
